utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes — it’s still happening, just moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll send the latest tool list and who can bring what.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — you’re sure it’s definitely Sunday at the community center now, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — once you’ve got the details, send me the tool list and who’s bringing what, and I’ll take a careful look.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll send over the tool list and who’s bringing what once I’ve gathered it. Thanks, Hana.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect — come early if you can, Mara, so you can catch the best volunteer fixers. Bring anything small that needs a little love, and I’ll see you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — I’ll swing by early and bring something small that needs a little love. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it, Mara — see you there, and bring whatever needs a little fixing!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still helping spread the word about the repair drive and keeping everyone in the loop. If you can sort donated tools or check off the repair list, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and check off the repair list. Just send me the location and time when you have them, and I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Cleo — I don’t have the date and drop-off spot locked in yet, but I’ll send them as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard a fresh update yet, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Same here — I’m still waiting on word too, but I’ll keep an ear out and pass it along once there’s news on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll do the same and let you know as soon as I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Faye — I’ll keep you posted as soon as I have the final location and time for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks, Opal — I’ll wait for your update and keep the schedule handy.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Faye — I’ll send the final location and time as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m still waiting on the time, but I’ll send the Sunday community center details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — Sunday at the community center, and I’ll wait for the time. Thanks for keeping me posted.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mina — I’ll let you know the time as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m happy to help, I just need a little reminder on what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Oren — could you bring any hand tools you’ve got, and let me know what time you can come by? I’m keeping the plan simple and steady.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I can bring my hand tools, and I can stop by around 10 in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll keep spreading the word—Sunday at the community center, and folks can bring screws, duct tape, glue, or spare tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Quinn — that’s perfect. I’ll keep telling folks Sunday at the community center and remind them to bring any screws, duct tape, glue, or spare tools they can share.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll keep nudging everyone I see so we get a good turnout Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, it’s still on — Sunday at the community center. I’ll send the time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Leo — Sunday at the community center works for me. Just send the time when it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll send the time as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’m here now. Point me to what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — the big stuff is the broken shelf by the entrance and the loose table in the back room. If you can take one of those, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll take the shelf by the entrance.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend you a drill and a hammer for the repair drive. If you want, I can also help figure out the date and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — Sunday at the community center should work. I’m a little worried about getting everything there, so the drop-off spot really helps.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great — Sunday at the community center sounds good. I can bring the drill and hammer by then, and I’ll help however I can with the drop-off setup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — I really appreciate it. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: See you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — see you Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Not yet—I’m still checking with folks before we pick a date and drop-off spot for the repair drive. If you’ve got anything needing a fix, come by early so we can catch the good volunteer fixers.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure it’s still happening, right? I just want to confirm before I tell anyone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, it’s still happening — I’m just sorting the date and drop-off spot first. I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got it nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I still haven’t heard the latest myself, but Vik said he’d let everyone know what’s next for the repair drive. I’ll check back and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still waiting on the latest details, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I get them. For now, the repair drive is still on my list, and I’ll let everyone know the date once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out and let folks know once the date is set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still waiting on the date and drop-off spot, so I’ll let everyone know as soon as Hana confirms them. Once that’s set, I’ll be there early to help sort the tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — I haven’t locked them in yet, so I’ll confirm the date and drop-off spot first. Then I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — thanks, Hana. I’ll be ready to share the details and help sort things once you confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks — once you have the repair drive location and time, send them over and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes — I’m expecting it to still happen, but I’m keeping the plan flexible in case the location or time shifts. I’ll send it over as soon as I have the final details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for the final repair drive location and time, and I’ll note any shifts. Thanks for the update.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mina — could you bring the drill and hammer to the community center on Sunday? That’ll help us a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes — it’s on Sunday now at the community center. I can bring the drill and hammer.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, thank you, Mina — that’s a big help. See you Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Bo — could you help sort the donated tools or check off the repair list? That would really keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — what do you need me to do first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Could you start by sorting the donated tools, then check items off the repair list as we go?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you lend a drill and a hammer for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure, I can help keep things tidy and check off the repair list. Just tell me where to drop the tools off.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Eli — I’ll let you know the drop-off spot as soon as I have the location and time for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — the repair drive’s this weekend, and folks are bringing tools, bikes, and small appliances. If you’ve got something to fix, come by early and I’ll spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that’s great — I’ll swing by early and let a couple neighbors know too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — thank you! I’ll keep passing it along, and if anyone needs a hand, tell them to bring it by early.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still not up to speed on the repair drive—what’s changed since last time?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly we’re still waiting on the time and drop-off spot. I’m keeping track of supplies, so I’ll let you know as soon as those details are set.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it—thanks. Just let me know when the time and drop-off spot are set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — Sunday at the community center works for me. Just send the time when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll send the time as soon as I have it. Thanks, Dane, and I’ll see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for the time. Thanks, Faye!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s for fixing up neighborhood stuff—tools, bikes, and small home repairs. Come Sunday at the community center; I’ll give you a job when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Got it — Sunday at the community center works. I’ll bring the tool list and see who can bring what.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, thanks — the tool list will help a lot. I’ll see you Sunday at the community center.
